scheme_name: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Interest Subsidy on Term Loan
other_conditions: Applicable to all eligible tourism projects/units and expansion projects of existing units set up on or after 22 February 2021
Eligible hotel units that started commercial operation between 7 January 2015 and 31 December 2020 but could not apply earlier due to absence of a Bar in the Hotel
Units may be in private, co‑operative, joint, or state‑owned sectors
Project must be covered by a detailed feasibility report/project and approved/sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, Commercial Bank or State Financial Institution
Unit must hold a Registration Certificate, Date of Commencement Certificate and Eligibility Certificate issued by the West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation Limited
Interest subsidy is not payable for term loans used to purchase second‑hand plant and machinery or hire‑purchase equipment
benefits_summary: Interest subsidy on term loan up to 75% of interest payable, subject to annual caps of ₹25‑30 lakh for 5‑7 years depending on the area.
